Dear partner,

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
Dear your company team,

You close by heading back to the machines—it sounds like you value a concise, practical discussion. We want a competitive agreement that is straightforward to execute. How can we use flexibility on delivery timing to achieve a sharper price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
